description:
reference: https://youtu.be/1ARIjf9IUTw?si=vU5M0gROoPtw98n2&t=232

Live at Louis Vuitton: Men's Fall-Winter 2022

composed by Tyler, The Creator

start in 03:52

this is nothing more or less than a song that can be used in the credits / staff roll, finally. but the samples you have there, I got them when they were making the music for the Wagyan Paradise SNES game, I'll even give the credits here:

@1 Major & Minor Sample: musicalman
@2+@3 Sample: Maxodex

that's why the option to sample usage is set to light, because there are .brr files there

in the output of the song I left it at the right tempo and speed the way the metronome is measuring it, not as the original

OBS.: I've reposted this here too because I had a mistake at the end of the song, the instrument finished later than everyone else, I've corrected it, it's now finishing at the same time as everyone else.

from August 10th to September 6th working on this song

Enjoy it! It will change your life.
